plates.quality_reason: Flow-first: a teach diagram, chart, counter or timeline is a £0 code graphic. No Flow mint.
plates.reference: Own code graphic: on period paper, the 4-date timeline completes: 1885 (Hermann Ebbinghaus in Berlin publishes the mathematical Forgetting Curve from 2,300 nonsense syllables) · 25 Aug 1953 & 1957 (William Scoville and Brenda Milner study Patient H.M., proving declarative memory requires the hippocampus while motor skill memory is separate) · 1966–1973 (Tim Bliss and Terje Lømo discover Long-Term Potentiation in the hippocampus) · 1983–2000 (Eric Kandel and Craig Bailey prove in Aplysia sea slugs that long-term memory activates CREB to double physical synaptic terminals from ~1,300 to ~2,600).
